issues.explanation: In each occurrence, 率 means “to lead” and is pronounced shuài, not lǜ.
issues.suggested_fix: pinyin: shuài; meaning: to lead

issues.explanation: Here 带 means “to bring/lead,” not “band.”
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: to bring; to lead

issues.explanation: 关羽 is a personal name and must remain together.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as name 关羽, pinyin Guān Yǔ.

issues.explanation: 两翼 means the two flanks/wings of the attacking force; 翼 is not a surname here.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep 两 and 翼 as ordinary words, with 翼 meaning wing/flank.

issues.explanation: In 解了青州之围, 解 means “to relieve/lift” a siege, not a surname.
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: to relieve; to lift

issues.explanation: 围 means an encirclement or siege in 青州之围, not a surname.
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: siege; encirclement

issues.explanation: 往 functions as a directional preposition meaning “to/toward,” not a particle meaning “to go.”
issues.suggested_fix: type: word; meaning_en: toward; to

issues.explanation: In both contexts, 令 means “to order/command,” not the unrelated reference “used in 脊令.”
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: to order; to command

issues.explanation: 百 is the number “hundred” in 五百人, not the surname Bai.
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: hundred

issues.explanation: This hides the natural words 风 and 火攻. The text means taking advantage of strong wind to launch a fire attack.
issues.suggested_fix: Segment as 风, 火攻; 火攻 means fire attack.

issues.explanation: 长社 is a place name and should not be interpreted as “long” plus “society.”
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as name 长社, pinyin Chángshè.

issues.explanation: The historical figure’s name is pronounced Zhū Jùn, not Zhū Juàn.
issues.suggested_fix: pinyin: Zhū Jùn

issues.explanation: 曹腾 is a personal name, while 养子 is the ordinary noun “adopted son.”
issues.suggested_fix: Segment as name 曹腾 + word 养子.

issues.explanation: After a person’s name, 字 introduces their courtesy name, not a letter.
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: courtesy name

issues.explanation: 好游猎 means “to enjoy hunting”; 好 is pronounced hào here, not hǎo.
issues.suggested_fix: pinyin: hào; meaning_en: to enjoy; to be fond of

issues.explanation: 善权谋 means “to be skilled at political strategy,” not simply “good.”
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: to be skilled at

issues.explanation: 曾 means “once/formerly” in 曾装病, not the surname Zeng.
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: once; formerly

issues.explanation: 装病 means “to pretend to be ill,” not “adornment.”
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: to pretend

issues.explanation: 孝廉 is a historical term for a recommended candidate/official, not separate “filial piety” and surname “Lian.”
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as word 孝廉, meaning recommended for office under the Han system.

issues.explanation: 任洛阳北部尉 means “to serve as/be appointed as,” not the surname Ren.
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: to serve as; to be appointed as

issues.explanation: 尉 is an official title in 洛阳北部尉, not a personal name.
issues.suggested_fix: type: word; meaning_en: commandant; military officer

issues.explanation: 以五色棒 means “using/with the five-colored staff,” not the abbreviation for Israel.
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: using; with

issues.explanation: 五色棒 is the named five-colored staff used for punishment; treating 棒 as a particle is incorrect.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as word 五色棒, meaning five-colored staff.

issues.explanation: 者 is a nominalizing particle in 犯禁者, meaning “those who violate the ban.”
issues.suggested_fix: type: particle

issues.explanation: 大震 is an ordinary verb phrase meaning “to resound greatly,” not a lexicalized idiom.
issues.suggested_fix: type: word; meaning_en: to resound greatly; to be greatly renowned

issues.explanation: 到颍川后 uses 后 as a temporal particle/noun meaning “after,” not the surname Hou.
issues.suggested_fix: type: particle; meaning_en: after

issues.explanation: 奉命 means “under orders/by command”; 奉 is not “to offer” here and 命 means an order, not “life.”
issues.suggested_fix: meanings: 奉 = to receive/obey; 命 = order; optionally merge 奉命.

issues.explanation: 左丰 is a personal name and should remain together.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as name 左丰, pinyin Zuǒ Fēng.

issues.explanation: 被诬陷下狱 uses 被 as the passive marker “be,” not “quilt.”
issues.suggested_fix: type: word or grammar marker; meaning_en: be; get (passive)

issues.explanation: 击败董卓时 means “when/at the time that,” not the surname Shi.
issues.suggested_fix: type: particle; meaning_en: when; at the time that

issues.explanation: 救了董卓 means “rescued Dong Zhuo”; the self-referential variant gloss does not explain the word.
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: to rescue; to save

issues.explanation: 轻慢 is a lexicalized word meaning to treat someone contemptuously; splitting it hides the useful word.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as word 轻慢, meaning to slight; to treat contemptuously.

issues.explanation: 无礼 is a lexicalized adjective meaning rude/disrespectful; splitting it hides the useful word.
issues.suggested_fix: Merge as word 无礼, meaning rude; disrespectful

issues.explanation: 怒而要杀他 means “became angry and wanted to kill him,” not the noun “anger.”
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: to become angry

issues.explanation: 要杀他 means “want/intend to kill him,” not the bound-form gloss “to demand.”
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: to want; to intend to

issues.explanation: In the storytelling formula 留待下回分解, 分解 means “to explain/reveal in the next installment,” not generally “to resolve.”
issues.suggested_fix: meaning_en: to explain; to reveal
